segments.text: Has Ian sold his house yet?
segments.instructions: Ask a genuine question with a gentle natural rise.

segments.text: Yes, he has.

segments.text: I think that they'll move in the day after tomorrow.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.

segments.text: Will you see Ian today, Jenny?

segments.text: Yes, I will.
